classification.difficultyReason: Set up suitable coordinate axes on the blank grid and translate each ordered pair into horizontal and vertical movement, including zero coordinates.

content.prompt: On a Cartesian plane, plot each of the following points. The coordinates of the points are given.

spec.description: Single blank grid for all listed points; students draw their Cartesian axes. Full original 100mm drawing height retained.

answer.worked: From the origin, move 1 unit right and 1 unit up. Mark and label $A$.
From the origin, move 2 units right and 3 units down. Mark and label $B$.
The horizontal coordinate is zero. Move 6 units up the vertical axis and mark $C$.
The vertical coordinate is zero. Move 4 units left along the horizontal axis and mark $D$.
From the origin, move 4 units left and 2 units down. Mark and label $E$.
From the origin, move 4 units left and 5 units up. Mark and label $F$.

spec.description: One complete shared solution plane with unit grid, numbered axes and all six labelled points. The source supplies no student plotting scaffold. Solution bounds are chosen to contain the required points legibly.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; the student draws the plane and points in one shared blank region.
